Start Text: Still willing to look into those reports? The ledgers are here. Read them before you go down. If you find a mark you recognize, make a copy and bring it back.
Help Text: Follow the Sergeant's leads into the dungeon and watch for sealed chambers, old symbols, or anything the patrol ledgers cannot explain.
End Text: Tomas died at the threshold. Mira's marks continued beyond it. Three patrol sketches fit Triangulus, and an older record shows six positions around an empty center. Bring any matching finds to Caedmon.

Start Text: Darn pesky rats keep getting into my food supply and I'd bet anything they come up from that dungeon. Help my out by killing as many as you need to collect 6 tails and I'll pay you 600 gold.
Help Text: Search the area around town on the first floor of the dungeon for those pesky little rat vermin.
End Text: Good riddance to the bastards, hopefully this will keep my food supplies in good order. Here's the gold I promised you.

Start Text: Oh man, I am so screwed...do you think you can help me? I let the waitress borrow my key to the tavern and the boss is gonna kill me if I don't get it back. Could you try and track her down for me and get the key back? This may be a long shot but I am desperate. People are saying she went crazy after her fiance died and she took off into the dungeon and hasn't been seen since. I know this sounds a bit heartless after what she's been through but she made her choice and now I have to pay for it. I don't have much but I can give you this potion my mom keeps on her mantle. She claims it makes her live longer but who knows whether that's true or not.
Help Text: Adventurers have told stories of hearing wailing on the second floor of the dungeon that sounds like a woman crying.
End Text: So she really did go crazy. It's sad what grief will do to a person...thanks for tracking her down but it turns out she left the tavern key in my locker before she left. Whatever this key is, it's not mine. You can keep it, maybe it'll unlock something useful. Here's that potion I promised you.

Start Text: Oh impressive, you have obtained the powerful Photon Sphere spell. Interested in making it more powerful? Of course you are, who wouldn't? Bring me the soul of a Lich and I will create an item on a scale hitherto undreamt of.
Help Text: A Lich is a powerful foe, do not underestimate them!
End Text: What a wonderful specimen you have brought me, this will do well in the ritual...oh right, here's that item I promised you.

Start Text: The old Barkeep keeps practical notes on the first descent. Ask him which route the newest adventurers are surviving, then follow his marked route before you report back to me.
Help Text: Speak with the Barkeep at the Thirsty Dog about the first descent.
End Text: Good. A prepared mage lives longer than a brilliant but lost one. Keep your eyes open for the stairs and do not mistake the first floor for the whole dungeon.

Start Text: We received a report about a small child named Timmy who somehow made it past my guards and into the dungeon. While my men have been punished accordingly, we still need to find the boy before something bad happens to him. Locate him (he shouldn't have gone far) and bring him home to his family.
Help Text: That kid must be an expert at hide-and-seek. I have sent several sentries to find him and haven't seen a trace. I guess there is an alternate outcome...let's not think that way.
End Text: Timmy is home with his parents.

Start Text: My wedding day is fast approaching and we are trying to save a few gold, so I am cooking the meal for the guests. If you could bring me back 12 pieces of mystery meat, I can reward you with this potion I received as a tip once.
Help Text: The wedding guests aren't picky when it comes to the food, so any animal meat will do.
End Text: Thank you, thank you, thank you! You have made my special day that much easier. Please take this as a token of my appreciation.

Start Text: My wedding day is fast approaching and we are trying to save a few gold, so I am cooking the meal for the guests. If you could bring me back 12 pieces of mystery meat, I can reward you with this potion I received as a tip once.
Help Text: The wedding guests aren't picky when it comes to the food, so any animal meat will do.
End Text: Thank you, thank you, thank you! You have made my special day that much easier. Please take this as a token of my appreciation.

Start Text: The first few dungeon levels conceal more than rats and rust. Bring me four Fungus Spores from the cave paths so I can finish a lantern reagent for explorers willing to seek deeper routes.
Help Text: Fungus Spores come from fungal growth and themed creature loot on the early dungeon floors.
End Text: These are fresh enough to hold their glow. Take this draught, and remember: when the first floor grows familiar, the stairs are an invitation rather than a wall.

Start Text: Hey, HEY, you! Can you...help me (hic)? I swear I had my ticket for the ra..raff...raffle in my left...no right pocket but it's no..(hic) nowhere to be found. I must have d...DROPPED it when I went down into the dungeon. It should be (hic) close to the stairs, I didn't go too far. Please find it for ME!
Help Text: They've got to be somewhere around here...WHERE IS IT!!!
End Text: That's it! Ah man...(hic), oh shoot, I didn't win...DAMN!!! Well...(hic) thanks anyways...OH yeah here's something for the ef..effort.

Start Text: That stair was open a week ago. Then the Minotaur came up from the lower passages and claimed the corridor before it. Patrols reached the second level before; now no patrol, rescue party, or explorer can go deeper. Kill the Butcher and I will give you the keys carried by the last people who tried.
Help Text: If you are having trouble finding the Minotaur, he is located north of the entrance to the town.
End Text: The stair is open again. That does not make it safe. Take the keys. Their last owners will not need them.

Start Text: Griswold knows which shipments arrive damaged before they reach my ledger. Ask him about the missing crates, then act on what you learn; call it an introduction to honest work.
Help Text: Speak with Griswold at the Blacksmith about Mara's missing crates.
End Text: You listened, remembered, and did not embellish. Those are rarer skills than a sharp knife.

Start Text: I need your help finding one of our new recruits. He went below before he was ready, and I let a barracks culture that praises risk convince him courage was the same thing as preparation. He has not come back. Find him, dead or alive, and bring him home.
Help Text: I'd be surprised if he made it out of the first level of the dungeon, so I'd start by searching there.
End Text: The recruit was buried in Silvana. His patrol clasp marks the grave.

Start Text: Too many keys from the old routes have fallen into untrained hands. Recover five before an amateur opens something they cannot close.
Help Text: Keys can be found in chests and carried by creatures on the early dungeon floors.
End Text: These keys will be catalogued or melted down. Either result is safer than leaving them in the dark.

Start Text: The thieves guild has placed an order for several sets of leather armor but my supply of materials is getting short at the moment. Say, you look capable enough, do you think you could retrieve some for me? I'll pay top dollar for them.
Help Text: I am able to fashion leather armor out of either fresh animal hides or by using scraps from old armor pieces.
End Text: I knew it when I first saw you that you were the person for the job. As promised here's some gold for your efforts.

Start Text: A reflection in my scrying glass points to an underground spring. Find the place itself and note how its water answers magic; I need proof, not another tavern rumor.
Help Text: Search the third dungeon floor for the Underground Spring.
End Text: So the spring is real. Your observation will spare several apprentices a dangerous guess.

Start Text: SNAKES! Oh my I hate those things... (hic) ...slithering about. It's unnatural...I think... (hic)...what was I saying?...Oh yeah, bring me some snake skins and I'll give you these poison curing thingies I found... (hic)
Help Text: Watch out for the snake's venom, as it can drain your health quickly.
End Text: WHY WOULD YOU BRING...oh yeah I asked you to... (hic) ..thanks I guess. Here's those things...ANTIDOTES, that's what they're called. BARKEEP, another beer please... (hic).

Start Text: Edrin recognized the pale eyes in Joffrey's bestiary. Two other patrols saw them near the sealed chamber. Hunt the Barghest and search the chamber.
Help Text: The locked door south of town leads toward the sealed chamber. Watch the eyes if it changes shape.
End Text: Here. The ring's yours. I'll tell the next patrol they can search that stretch again.

Start Text: As you may or may not know, all of my tinctures are created here in my lab. I need some more ingredients to make more Phoenix Down potions, so any Feathers that you find I will pay you for them.
Help Text: Birds have feathers, so try killing some birds. You may also find them on other enemies, as bird is a favorite dish to eat.
End Text: Excellent! Here's the gold I promised, spend it wisely.

Start Text: I've matched your relic against the old ledgers. The names and shapes are damaged, but the pattern is too consistent to ignore. Six reports. Six sealed chambers. Six objects that made wounded soldiers sound like priests and liars at the same time. I won't pretend I understand what they are, but the final threshold reacts to this kind of power. Recover the rest before something down there decides the pattern for us.
Help Text: The relics appear tied to sealed chambers and powerful guardians. Recover each one you find; the Sergeant is comparing their markings against old patrol reports.
End Text: Six relics, six reports, and somehow the ledgers make less sense than when we started. Still, the final threshold answers to them. I don't know if they are weapons, keys, or warnings, but they are the only proof we have that the way ahead can be opened and survived.

Start Text: One of my runners heard a wind where no wind should be. Find the draft on the third floor and learn whether it marks a route worth putting on a private map.
Help Text: Search the third dungeon floor for an unnatural draft among the cave paths.
End Text: A hidden route is worth more than a full purse when the purses run dry. You have earned a share.

Rewards: StrengthPotion; IntelPotion; WisdomPotion; ConPotion; CharismaPotion; DexterityPotion
Start Text: The city guard are in desperate need of new equipment but we unfortunately are running short on the required materials. If you can bring back 8 pieces of scrap metal, I can use my connections with the alchemist shop and get you a really nice potion for your troubles.
Help Text: There are a few sources of metal that would be usable, including broken equipment, metal constructs, and enemies that consume items.
End Text: You are a life saver, literally. This metal will help to fortify the town against the scum that patrols the dungeon. Take one of these potions as a token of my appreciation.

Start Text: My rival, a wizard known for unimaginable cruelty, is looking to increase her power by upgrading her familiar. She has her eyes set on a particular creature, a Pseudodragon, that dwells in the dungeon below. Destroy this creature before she can corrupt it and I will reward you.
Help Text: Do not mistake the Pseudodragon's miniature size, for its power is very potent. Beware of the deadly Fireball spell, as it can be devastating.
End Text: You have done well in taking care of this threat. Take this reward and use it wisely.

Start Text: Let me tell you a quick story...back in the day I used to be an adventurer. My friend and I had delved too deep into the dungeon below and were trapped with no escape. A giant bird-looking monstrosity had us pinned...we made a run for it...but we weren't fast enough. I still remember the look on Rutger's face as he turned to stone in front of me...this necklace is the only reason I am still here. If you come across the beast, make sure it's dead before you are. (hic)...hmmm...what was I sayin'?
Help Text: Rutger and I were on the 3rd floor of the dungeon when we encountered the Cockatrice. Make sure you prepare for the powerful enemies on your way.
End Text: Rutger can now be at peace...I can finally let go of the past (hic). Here, take this necklace, I don't need it anymore...

Start Text: I've heard many tales about the creatures that reside in the depths of the dungeon but the story I will tell you may take the cake. Evil and malice are bad enough but there may be nothing more vile than torture and fear. One such legend of the cruel Nightmare tells of a callous disregard for the sanctity of the mercy, toying with its food with panic and terror, leaving nothing but an empty statue before finishing them off.
Help Text: Subterfuge will not work on this steed, who sees and hears all. That and the whole 'made of fire' thing. Oh and it can fly, unreal.
End Text: Good to see you returned intact, both physically and mentally. Not everyone has been as lucky...take this gold as a reward.

Start Text: This morning I woke in a sweat...I dreamed I was standing in a small room and to my horror a great flaming horse struck down my betrothed...please find my Joffrey before my dream truly becomes a nightmare...
Help Text: An adventurer came in earlier. He said he saw Joffrey on the second floor of the dungeon. Joffrey had just unlocked a door in the northeast corner.
End Text: My pendant...Elysia take me...he left me these keys last I saw of him...please avenge my love...(the waitress runs out sobbing...)

Start Text: The Guild's locks and tools do not replace themselves. Bring me ten pieces of Scrap Metal from the depths and I will see that you are paid for every useful ounce.
Help Text: Scrap Metal comes from constructs, broken equipment, and enemies that consume metal.
End Text: This will keep our doors opening for the right people. Your payment is already counted.

Start Text: My stock of beer is running low and my supplier says the reason is a shortage of the hops used to make it. The previous owner of the tavern once told me about a form of hops that could be found within the depths. He claimed it makes the most delicious drink you've ever tasted. If you could get me a few of them, I'll make sure you are the first to try it once it's done brewing. I'll also throw in some gold for your troubles.
Help Text: Hops can be found growing on certain types of flowering plants. I am not sure how many plants you'll find down there...
End Text: I don't believe it, I was sure the old coot was out of his mind with that tale but you found them! Come back later and I'll save you a glass. Also here's some gold for your troubles.

Start Text: I need fat..no not for eating. We have many lamps throughout the church that require fuel and one of the primary sources is a special type of fat from a Golden Eagle. Three should be enough to last for quite some time. I can't offer you payment but I can offer you information that may be specifically interesting to you. I look forward to your return.
Help Text: The Golden Eagle can be found on the third floor of the dungeon. Be careful of it piercing call, for it can deafen you.
End Text: Excellent work! This will keep us going and help us continue to do our good work. Now for your reward...while I do not condone the art of witchcraft, we sometimes must ally with some less than savory characters to defeat a greater evil. Follow me...

Quest: The Power of Elysia Compels You!
Start Text: While the depths of the dungeon are home to many a horrible creature, the Wendigo is a curse to our very soul. Vanquish this monstrosity and Elysia will reward you with a boon.
Help Text: As with many creatures of the night, your best option for cleansing the world of the Wendigo is Fire. Stay away from using Ice magic.
End Text: Some order has been restored, although more work is to be done. Take this gift and use it to continue the good fight.

Start Text: An adventurer brought me this magical potion the other day, asking me to make more for them. He offered to pay me a small fortune, as these Elixirs are very powerful and very rare. Unfortunately I need some pure spring water, as the water here in town is much too polluted. Take this empty vial and fill it with some if you happen to come across one and I will give you any extras I make.
Help Text: I've heard that the spring is somewhere on the 3rd floor but I cannot confirm that.
End Text: Hmmm...how do I know that this isn't regular water...well for one, it's not dark brown! I honestly wasn't even sure if there was a spring in the dungeon or if the water was as pure as needed. Give me just a sec, this won't take long.....................................................................that about does it. Here you go, thanks for your help!

Rewards: FireAmulet; IceAmulet; ElectricAmulet; WaterAmulet; EarthAmulet; WindAmulet
Start Text: Only a powerful wizard is capable of creating a golem and a truly powerful wizard must have created the Iron Golem. While we do not know who created this monstrosity, the fact is you will not be able to get to the 5th floor without taking it out.
Help Text: Do not let the Iron Golem get its hands on you, as it will literally crush you to oblivion.
End Text: I shouldn't be surprised at this point but again you've done what was thought impossible. Choose your reward and good luck going forward, although it doesn't seem that you need much luck...

Quest: Earth, Wind, and Fire...and Water and...
Start Text: Long before I owned this shop, I was apprentice to a master craftsman. He taught me how to make a very powerful item called an Elemental Amulet, which requires the core of 6 elementals. However I have never been able to make this item since I was never able to obtain the components. Bring me the 6 Elemental Motes and the pendant will be yours.
Help Text: The elemental beasts known as Myrmidons come in many variations. Unfortunately the only way to know what type you are fighting is to see what elements work or don't work against them.
End Text: Absolutely amazing, I doubted if I would ever be able to put this skill to the test. Please wait a moment while I place these motes into the amulet...here you go, I hope it serves you well!

Start Text: Legend says that Merzhin was sired from the union of a virgin and a demon, resulting in a powerful being with the cunning of a demon and the resilience of a human. The Incubus is said to be Merzhin's father, and it is rumored that he still lurks in the depths below. If you can find and defeat him, I will reward you with something that may help you on your quest.
Help Text: The Incubus is a master of illusion and manipulation, using sleep and terror to frighten his foes. Be cautious of his abilities that can drain your health and mana.
End Text: You have defeated the Incubus, a feat that many have attempted but few have accomplished. This creature is a powerful foe, and you should be proud of your victory. As a reward, take this pendant. It is said to make you harder to hit by magic, which may come in handy as you face the challenges ahead.

Start Text: A Lich has turned scholarship into an excuse for cruelty. End its research before its notes find their way into the wrong hands.
Help Text: Liches haunt the deepest dungeon floors and command dangerous arcane magic.
End Text: Its work is ash, and its knowledge will remain buried. Take this elixir for the battles that still demand more from you.

Start Text: The depths are guarded by a powerful Red Dragon. Treat the encounter as a barrier, not a trophy; draconic power leaves echoes in more than one shape. If you can survive her, the path below will open.
Help Text: The Red Dragon is your toughest test yet, with access to some of the strongest abilities. Defeating the boss opens the path to the 6th floor. Some class paths may reveal separate truths in the aftermath, but the progression victory is complete for every hero.
End Text: You have passed the dragon's trial and proven you can stand before power without mistaking it for certainty. Take this ring. It is not awake; each path must learn how to rouse it in its own way. Pursue the depths with care.

Quest: In the Day of Our Lord
Start Text: Many years ago, an explorer returned with a magical egg that was said to contain a powerful creature. Our scientists made many attempts to hatch the creature but were unsuccessful until recently when they had a breakthrough when they simple placed it in our chicken incubator. We had hoped to use this creature to protect the city from the monsters below but found out quickly that we could not hope to control it and had locked it away. However, someone inexplicably let the creature out. It killed 6 of my men before it disappeared into the dungeon. Find the creature and destroy it.
Help Text: The magical creature excels at, you guessed it, magic. Look out for the powerful Photon Sphere spell. The scientists will not risk opening the deeper warp until Domingo is gone.
End Text: It's a shame we had to kill it but there is no point trying to control the uncontrollable. The head scientist sends his thanks and as a reward, the research crew has finished construction of a staffed warp point that will allow you to teleport directly to the 5th dungeon level.

Start Text: I came across an old dusty tome while cleaning out the belongings of my mentor. Most of it contained random armor designs but there was a loose piece of parchment that contained a blueprint for a way to increase a person's defensive prowess, however it requires some hard to find items. The hardest to come by is a nuclear power core, which sounds fake and may actually be, who knows? If by some miracle you find one, bring it to me and you will reap the benefit.
Help Text: I met an old wizard at the tavern who mentioned that power cores do indeed exist. I don't know how he knows this but he seems pretty credible. Maybe they are used to power something of incredible size?
End Text: So a power core is the secret to creating golems? This bit of information may prove to be more valuable than any thing I could give you. I do have an idea though. There may be a way to harness the power into you. If you're up for it of course. Step into the back and we will start the process.

Start Text: Your strength and courage have both been tested. Now you must seek that which was lost—the Golden Chalice, a sacred vessel imbued with ancient power. It lies hidden somewhere in the depths below, guarded by trials and riddles. Many have sought it; few have found it. If you can locate this relic and bring it to me, you will have proven yourself worthy of Merzhin's defeat. The chalice will amplify your spirit and prepare you for the trials ahead.
Help Text: The Golden Chalice was lost in the deepest levels long ago. Speak with the travelers and keepers of knowledge throughout the dungeon—they may provide clues to its location. Search wisely.
End Text: You have found the Golden Chalice! Its holy radiance fills my spring, and I can feel the balance of power shifting in your favor. You are truly ready now. When you wish to enter the Realm of Cambion and face Merzhin, return to me. The chalice's blessing will guide you through his illusions.

Start Text: Hey...it's been rough recently. So much death and misery. Oh yes, this is a water, I chose to give up drinking. It didn't seem right to get blasted when people like you are sacrificing everything for us. One of the doctor's came in earlier, telling us a story about one of the bodies returned from the dungeon. The body was badly charred with giant chunks missing. I can't even fathom what that does to a person to see that much carnage. Rumor has it the beast that is to blame is the three-headed hellhound called Cerberus, the guardian of the final relic. I know you're looking for that anyways and you will have to take it out to get it, so hopefully we can sweeten the pot a bit. Take care of yourself.
Help Text: Cerberus is no joke. Obviously fire is a no go but I'd imagine dispel is also very useful. Hit 'em hard and hit 'em fast.
End Text: This is a huge step towards saving us from the blight that has infected this land. We all owe you a debt of gratitude. Everyone in the town pitched in to get this for you. Please finish what you started before it's too late.

Start Text: During my first week of training, a senior officer told us a story about a former recruit who went mad. He was a bit of an outcast and many of the other soldiers bullied him for his weirdness, as it was told. He had a fondness for card tricks and claimed he was an 'Agent of Chaos', whatever that means...anyway, he finally cracked one day and disappeared, never to be heard from again...that is until we started receiving the body parts...the freak has been sending back parts of adventurers with notes talking about revenge and signed by the Jester. Someone needs to take this sick bastard out before anyone else gets hurt. Be careful, you never truly know what you may get with this guy.
Help Text: The Jester has a bag full of tricks. Word is he even has the ability to change his resistances each round to keep you on your toes.
End Text: Excellent work! Hopefully the souls of those tortured by the Jester will be able to rest now. This magical ring was shipped back with one of the body parts, it increases your chance to evade attacks in combat. I'm sure the Jester thought he was being clever, since it took so long for someone to finally catch him. It's fitting that you would wear it now.

Start Text: You have proven yourself worthy. Now I shall grant you passage to the Realm of Cambion, where Merzhin awaits. He is a master of illusion and deception, and the realm beyond my spring bends itself around his will. Navigate his tricks, find him in the labyrinth, and defeat him. Only then will you have my eternal gratitude. Be warned: nothing in his realm is as it seems.
Help Text: Nimue can send you into the Realm of Cambion from the Underground Spring. Merzhin resides deep within that shifting maze. Trust nothing you see, and be prepared for his mind games.
End Text: At last, Merzhin has been vanquished! His illusions fade and his realm crumbles. You have done what I could not—freed me from his relentless torment. Take this blade, forged from the waters of my spring. It carries my blessing and will serve you well in the battles to come. May the waters guide you, champion.

Start Text: I am so glad you stopped in, I really need your help. My baby brother, Chisolm, has been missing for far too long. He regularly goes into the dungeon but never for this long. Please help me find him and I will forever be indebted to you.
Help Text: I haven't the faintest idea where Chisolm may be but he is a strong warrior and I have no doubt he is still alive. I have heard rumors of secret passageways in the depths but they have never been confirmed.
End Text: By the light of Elysia, you have found him! I must admit I had given up hope. It comes at no surprise that he chose to stay in the depths to help those in need, perhaps he will choose to come home once the primal evil has been vanquished. As a reward, take this key—Chisolm told me of a vault deep below where legendary ore is kept. This key will grant you access.
